label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the user-provided parameter 'param' which is concatenated into the 'bar' string and then used in the response writer's printf method. The data flows from request.getParameterNames() through param to bar and finally to the sink object array used in response.getWriter().printf(), making it vulnerable to XSS.

evidence.note: getParameterNames(...) retrieves user-provided values from request
param is assigned from the user-provided value and passed to doSomething
StringBuilder appends param to create bar, which is returned and used in the sink
The bar value is used in response.getWriter().printf() which is an HTML sink
